title: Whirlbash
blueprint: A 3D spinning-top arena brawler in the io style, solo or online: you and 11 rival tops (real players online, with bots filling empty seats) share a bowl-shaped stadium ringed by bumper walls and open pits. Collect sparks to grow your spin (spin is both health and size), dash into rivals to drain their spin, and shove them into the pits for big ring-out points while arena events (Spark Storm, Arena Tilt, Overdrive) shake things up. Two modes: Endless (climb to #1; the Champion boss enters after about 2.5 minutes) and Last Top Spinning (no respawns, a closing ring, about 3 minutes). Three arenas: the Grand Bowl, the Turntable (a spinning centre disc that recharges spin, plus bumper pillars) and the Shutter Ring (six pits, three open at a time, swapping every 9 seconds). Six skill power-ups (Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor, Decoy) must be used within 10 seconds. A player level with XP, level rewards (modes, arenas, parts, level-only paints), three daily missions and personal records give every run a goal; gears unlock crown, core, tip and paint parts in the Garage. Controls: WASD/arrows or mouse to steer, Space or click to dash, E or right click for the power-up, P to pause; touch uses a floating joystick, tap to dash and a power button. A midgame ad plays only when starting a new run from the results screen; an optional rewarded ad doubles the gears earned on the results screen.
description: Spin up your top and battle in a glowing night stadium, solo against 11 rival tops or online against real players, with no account needed. Grab sparks to grow bigger, dash into rivals to drain their spin, and knock them into the open pits for a ring out. Time your charge for a Perfect hit, fire skill power-ups (Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor and Decoy) within 10 seconds before they fade, and take down the Champion, a giant boss top, for a huge bounty. Play Endless to climb to #1, or Last Top Spinning, where nobody respawns and the ring closes in. Level up to unlock the Turntable and Shutter Ring arenas, finish three daily missions, beat your personal records, invite friends to a private room with a link, and spend your gears in the Garage on crowns, cores, tips and paints that change how your top fights.

controls.desktop: WASD / Arrow keys or move the mouse to steer. Space or left click: dash. E or right click: use your power-up. P: pause.
controls.mobile: Drag anywhere to steer with the floating joystick. Tap the screen or the bolt button to dash. Tap the power button to use your power-up.

ads.midgame: Only when the player taps 'Play again' on the results screen (between runs, solo or online; the SDK caps it at one every 3 minutes)
ads.rewarded: Optional 'Double gears' button on the results screen, once per run; hidden when ads are unavailable or fail

quality.hook: Compared with Spinner.io, Attack.IO Spins Battle and Super Spinners (endless open arenas where you only grow and bump), Whirlbash is about positioning: the stadium has bumper walls and open pits, so the best plays are ring-outs where you shove a rival into a pit, and timed Perfect charges reward skill. Arena events change the fight every 40 seconds, the #1 top carries a double-points bounty, the Champion boss crashes long runs, three arenas change the rules (a spinning turntable, pits that open and close), a battle-royale mode closes the ring, and the same arena runs online: Quick Match or a private room with an invite link, no account needed.
quality.onboarding: The first run is a guided tutorial inside real gameplay: four coach cards with key or gesture icons and at most six words each (move, grab the highlighted ring of sparks, dash into a practice top, push rivals toward the pits, with floor chevrons pointing at the nearest pit). Rival bots stay passive and your spin does not decay until it ends, and a Skip button is always visible.
quality.art_style: One procedural look: glossy toy-plastic tops built in Three.js from crown, core and tip parts in eight saturated paints, a cobalt bowl stadium with coral/cream bumper walls and hazard-striped pits, a night-indigo sky with light beams and a boxy crowd. The UI uses Lilita One titles, Nunito text and flat inline SVG icons in the same palette. Covers are rendered from the game itself, so the cover, menu and gameplay all match.
quality.content: Two modes: Endless runs against 11 bots of four skill and aggression levels that respawn bigger as the run goes on (aggression ramps over two minutes, the Champion boss enters at about 2.5 minutes and again later), and Last Top Spinning (no respawns, a ring that closes over about 2.5 minutes, placement rewards). Three arenas unlocked by level: Grand Bowl, Turntable (spinning disc that carries tops and recharges spin, bumper pillars), Shutter Ring (six pits, three open, swapping every 9 s). Three rotating arena events every ~38 seconds; six skill power-ups (Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor, Decoy) with a 10-second use-it-or-lose-it timer; bots use them too. Progression: player level with XP from runs and missions, rewards at levels 2-15 (Last Top mode at 2, Turntable at 3, Shutter Ring at 5, parts and three level-only paints), three daily missions from a pool of twelve, personal records (score, knockouts, ring outs, time at #1, peak spin, longest run, Last Top wins), 23 garage items (4 crowns, 4 cores, 4 tips with real stat trade-offs plus 11 paints) unlocked with gears or levels.
quality.name_check: 'Whirlbash' is an invented word (whirl + bash) that says spinning and smashing. A web search found no game with that name, it uses no words from the spinning-top toy franchises, and it does not read as a plain genre label.
quality.visual_review: Checked menu, gameplay (1216x684 and 800x450 touch), standalone build and all three covers at full size. Fixed: empty leaderboard during the countdown, tutorial coach appearing before the countdown ended, a grey smudge from the floor emblem, bot names too small at 800x450, score and knockout icons looking alike, and a blown-out white blob in the cover clash plus oversized foreground sparks. No T-poses (all tops are procedural and always spinning), no overlapping UI text (every screen sits on an opaque card), and the covers are rendered in-engine so they match the gameplay. Version 1.1: camera follow smoothed (small velocity lead, eased look target, shake capped and smooth instead of random jitter, plus a camera-shake toggle in the pause menu) after a player reported motion sickness on hits and topples; online lobby, room chip and results checked in two-browser tests. Version 1.2: mobile audit at 844x390, 667x375 and 390x844 with touch emulation; fixed a cut-off garage Done button, oversized leaderboard, 30 px pause button, too-close phone camera and tiny labels; touch controls now switch on at the first touch, a quick tap anywhere dashes, and safe-area insets are respected. Version 1.3: checked the menu (level bar, mode and arena pickers with level locks, stat preview) at 1216x684 and 800x450 touch, the Missions screen, the garage hover preview and level-locked paints, results with XP, level-up and record chips, the Turntable disc and pillars, the Shutter Ring doors, the Champion (gold spike crown, boss bar), Anchor and Decoy, and Last Top Spinning. Fixed: the closing ring was too faint (added a red hazard overlay outside the safe zone), the turntable disc was invisible (back faces), floating texts piled up during skipped time, the mission popup covered event banners (moved to the bottom), and bots landing Perfect hits made runs shorter (Perfect is now a player-only skill reward; median bot run is back to about 2 minutes).

press.headline: {studio} launches Whirlbash, a spinning-top arena brawler playable instantly in the browser
press.summary: Whirlbash drops players into a glowing night stadium with 11 rival spinning tops, solo or online against real players. Grab sparks to grow, dash to clash, and knock rivals into the open pits for a ring out, while arena events, six skill power-ups and a giant Champion boss keep every round unpredictable. Two modes (Endless and the battle-royale style Last Top Spinning), three arenas, a player level with rewards and daily missions give players a goal every time. It runs instantly in any modern browser on desktop and mobile, with no download or account required.
features: Physics clashes: spin is your health and your size, and every hit drains it; a well-timed charge lands a Perfect hit
Two modes: Endless, and Last Top Spinning with no respawns and a closing ring
Three arenas: the Grand Bowl, the Turntable with its spinning disc and pillars, and the Shutter Ring where pits open and close
The Champion: a giant boss top that storms the arena, with a 250-point bounty
Six skill power-ups, Blast, Shield, Magnet, Turbo, Anchor and Decoy, but use them within 10 seconds or lose them
Player levels, daily missions and personal records, with arenas, modes and exclusive paints to unlock
Online multiplayer with no account: Quick Match or a private room with an invite link
Garage with crowns, cores, tips and paints that change attack, defense, stamina and speed
Plays with keyboard, mouse or touch, in English and Turkish
press.quote: We wanted the thrill of two tops grinding against each other at full speed, and the pits turn every clash into a decision: push now, or wait for the angle.

modes: Private room with invite link or 5-letter code
